cause: The six old containers were removed, but their bind-mounted private Unix socket inodes persisted. The replacement Gateway remained in retry while its learner-relay servers could not bind those stale paths and never emitted its readiness marker.
correctionPolicy: Retain every v3 artifact; use a fresh v4 identity; after Docker confirms removal of the six old services, validate and unlink only the five exact socket inodes owned by those stopped model-adapter and Gateway processes; refuse non-socket or symlink paths; and still require Gateway readiness before starting the replacement Controller.
claimBoundary: This stopped readiness gate is not a passing qualification, behavioral result, B12 closure, or publication result.
